description: Adds exploration and quest content to the game through a fork of the LOST_SECTOR mod. It was originally created for personal use to fix issues that had been bothering the author after the departure of the original mod's developer. The mod focuses on narrative-driven exploration and includes new content for players seeking deeper story elements.
